description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Software Engineer based in the United States. 

 Overview: 

 We are seeking an experienced AI Software Engineer to help shape the future of AI-first software development for enterprise-scale, cloud-native SaaS solutions. In this role, you will combine strong backend engineering expertise with hands-on experience using AI coding agents and advanced development platforms to build scalable, reliable applications. You will contribute directly to production code while helping engineering teams integrate AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity, code quality, testing, and troubleshooting. Working across Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, you will design and maintain distributed systems and modern cloud architectures. You will also help establish repeatable AI development practices, balancing innovation with security, maintainability, and engineering standards. This is an opportunity to influence modern software engineering practices while contributing to products used by organizations worldwide.



Accountabilities:
 
 Contribute to the development and evolution of cloud-native SaaS products while helping establish AI-first engineering practices across the development team. Apply advanced AI-assisted development techniques throughout the software lifecycle, ensuring that solutions remain scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with business and technical objectives.


 
 Drive the adoption of AI-first software development practices across the engineering team.



 
 Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development platforms extensively in daily engineering activities, including solution design, implementation, automated testing, debugging, troubleshooting, refactoring, code reviews, and technical documentation.



 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, serverless, cloud-native SaaS capabilities using C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure technologies.



 
 Build and maintain cloud solutions using Azure Functions, Microsoft Graph API, Azure Data Explorer, Cosmos DB, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps (ACA), and Event Hubs.



 
 Develop scalable backend services and cloud-native applications using Python, TypeScript, and AWS technologies, including EKS, DynamoDB, S3, and Lambda Functions.



 
 Create reusable prompts, agent instructions, development workflows, validation processes, and guardrails to ensure consistent and responsible AI-assisted engineering.



 
 Apply AI coding tools to improve software design, development efficiency, code quality, test coverage, debugging, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.



 
 Contribute to architectural decisions, technical design discussions, and ownership of critical product components.



 
 Participate in code reviews, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), release readiness, and ongoing product maintenance.



 
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams in an Agile Scrum environment to deliver reliable software solutions.



 
 Promote engineering best practices and continuously identify opportunities to improve development workflows through AI and automation.




 Requirements: 

 The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong backend development and cloud architecture expertise, combined with practical experience integrating AI-powered coding tools into real-world software engineering workflows. They should demonstrate strong technical judgment, the ability to design maintainable distributed systems, and the communication skills needed to influence development practices within an Agile team.


 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



 
 At least 5 years of professional software development experience.



 
 Strong hands-on programming experience with C#/.NET and Python.



 
 Demonstrated professional experience using AI coding agents, AI-assisted development platforms, or agentic development workflows as a significant part of production software development.



 
 Advanced practical experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Windsurf, or comparable AI-powered development tools.



 
 Ability to design reusable prompts, agent instructions, development workflows, validation steps, and guardrails for responsible AI-assisted software development.



 
 Proven ability to leverage AI coding tools to improve software design, implementation productivity, code quality, automated testing, debugging, refactoring, code reviews, and technical documentation.



 
 Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure using event-driven, service-based, or microservices architectures.



 
 Strong understanding of scalable backend services, distributed systems, and cloud-native application development.



 
 Knowledge of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and SOLID principles.



 
 Strong understanding of secure software development, automated testing, continuous integration, debugging, and maintainable software architecture.



 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to contribute to technical discussions and collaborate effectively within an Agile development team.




 Preferred Qualifications:


 
 Experience developing and maintaining YAML-based CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or comparable technologies.



 
 Familiarity with Azure OpenAI Service, large language model APIs, AI evaluation frameworks, observability tools, or AI application security.



 
 Experience with frontend development using Angular or React and TypeScript.



 
 Experience working with PySpark (Python and Apache Spark).




 Benefits: 


 
 Competitive compensation package.



 
 Eligibility for annual performance-based bonuses.



 
 Comprehensive employee benefits.



 
 Flexible work arrangements.



 
 Generous paid time off (PTO).



 
 Wellness programs and resources.



 
 Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.



 
 Access to mentorship and leadership development programs.



 
 Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale commercial software used by customers worldwide.



 
 Collaborative international team environment.



 
 Opportunity to influence and shape AI-assisted software development practices across an established engineering organization.



 
 Fully remote work arrangement.






How Jobgether works:

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
